I’m a Product Specialist in ASEE’s Banking Department, working where payment systems, software delivery, and operations meet.

My responsibilities include requirements analysis, Financial Gateway configuration, payment-message mapping, SQL development, API validation, deployment support, and technical troubleshooting. I work with clients, developers, and infrastructure teams to identify dependencies and resolve issues across the complete transaction flow.

At Kubit, I worked on ERP implementations for Kosovo clients, including finance and accounting, inventory, point-of-sale, and fuel-management workflows. My earlier technical and management responsibilities at Astronik established a foundation in service delivery, troubleshooting, and team coordination.

01 / ASEE

PAYMENTS & SYSTEM INTEGRATION

Financial Gateway
and payment integrations

Financial Gateway implementation and configuration across domestic and international payment workflows.

ISO 20022SWIFT MT / MXSEPA · RTGS · ACH
Responsibilities and implementation details

The challenge

A payment crosses multiple systems. Message structure, routing, authentication, and status handling must fit the bank’s workflow.

My contribution

  • Configure Financial Gateway integrations, payment routing, and XML message mappings.
  • Test API endpoints and authentication with Postman, and investigate processing issues through logs and SQL records.
  • Work with backend connectors for SWIFT and SEPA incoming processing, and serverless workflows and SQL procedures for ACH and RTGS.
  • Support ISO 20022 message families including pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.054, and camt.056.
  • Investigate payment initiation, incoming processing, confirmations, returns, and message-status discrepancies across application and database records.
  • Document connector configuration, integration prerequisites, message flows, and operational checks; train banking IT teams on configuration and monitoring.

Delivery focus

Consistent message handling, traceable transaction status, and an operational handover the bank can use.

02 / ASEE

DEPLOYMENT & TECHNICAL OPERATIONS

Application deployment
and production support

Hands-on deployment support and troubleshooting across Kubernetes, Linux, IIS, and Windows Services.

KubernetesHelm / HelmfileDockerLinux
Responsibilities and implementation details

The challenge

Application behavior depends on the environment around it: service configuration, networking, certificates, and infrastructure health.

My contribution

  • Prepare and maintain environment configuration and application versions for UAT and production deployments.
  • Support deployments and upgrades with Kubernetes, Helm, Helmfile, and MicroK8s.
  • Investigate pod scheduling, service connectivity, DNS, ingress, and application startup issues.
  • Support IIS applications, Windows Services, and certificate configuration alongside infrastructure teams.
  • Investigate node readiness, container runtime failures, pending or terminating pods, DNS resolution, and service-to-ingress connectivity.
  • Check certificates, endpoint access, connection strings, and application configuration during deployment and incident investigation.
  • Use application and platform logs to identify contributing causes, coordinate recovery actions, and document repeatable troubleshooting steps.

Delivery focus

Repeatable changes, clear environment configuration, and a practical route from an incident to its cause.

03 / ASEE

DATA & WORKFLOW AUTOMATION

Transaction processing
and database integration

SQL procedures, serverless functions, and integration logic connecting payment initiation, incoming messages, and confirmations.

SQL ServerServerlessREST APIsJSON / XML
Responsibilities and implementation details

The challenge

Core banking and payment platforms represent the same transaction differently. Identifiers, statuses, and account mappings need to remain consistent.

My contribution

  • Work on outgoing candidate selection, incoming message storage, and status confirmation procedures.
  • Connect serverless functions with SQL Server databases and payment APIs.
  • Investigate transaction identifiers, field mappings, and message-processing discrepancies.
  • Support scheduled SQL Agent jobs and data synchronization between SQL Server and IBM DB2 (AS/400) environments.
  • Work with stored procedures, views, functions, and transaction identifiers to support candidate selection, incoming processing, and confirmations.
  • Validate account mappings, duplicate-handling behavior, and processing-status updates when investigating integration discrepancies.

Delivery focus

Clear links between the original transaction, the gateway message, and the resulting processing status.
